name: Blessings of the Great Cat Spirit
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.
footerSourceNote: This quest is new in Forever: its text, givers, objectives and rewards come from Wowhead’s Forever database until the beta confirms them. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Now that you have received my blessing, return to Dendrite. He will instruct you further. I do hope we meet again someday.

May the shadows forever hide you and your foes easily fall prey to your claws, young one.
narrative.offerRewardText: <Dendrite makes another invisible gesture in the air above him as you approach. Another aura of power comes over him, and he smiles ever so slightly.>I sense the cunning and ferocity of the cat within you that was not present when I sent you to meet the Great Cat Spirit. In your eyes I can sense you now understand the stealth and speed needed to adopt this nature.Now you may learn to focus your cunning and adopt the true nature of the cat and call upon its spirit.

chain.subtitle: 6 quests at level 20, 3,650 XP in all.

quests.name: The Great Cat Spirit
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Dendrite Starblaze in the village of Nighthaven, Moonglade.

quests.name: The Great Windborne Cat Spirit
quests.objectiveText: Seek out the Avatar of Saeyleenan in southern part Moonglade and learn what it has to share with you about the nature of the windborne cat.

quests.name: The Great Cat Spirit
quests.objectiveText: Seek out the Great Cat Spirit in southern part Moonglade and learn what it has to share with you about the nature of the cat.

quests.name: The Great Cat Spirit
quests.objectiveText: Recover the Relic of the Fang, Relic of the Claw, and Relic of the Silent Shadow from the Stormrage Barrow Den, and return them to the Great Cat Spirit.

quests.name: Blessings of the Great Cat Spirit
To Thunder Bluff
quests.objectiveText: Return to Thunder Bluff and speak with Turak Runetotem on the Elder Rise.
